title: Academia catalog - core seed (universities -> mapped entities)
source: Public record: university & company founding histories; patent assignments (e.g., Stanford PageRank US6285999B1 assigned to Stanford, licensed to Google); alumni records. Structural overlay; edges graded in notes. First block of the academia/catalogs epic (schema validation).
grade: fact except where a note marks otherwise

edges.notes: Brin & Page founded Google out of Stanford PhD research; the PageRank patent (US6285999B1) was assigned to Stanford and exclusively licensed to Google, Stanford taking equity (fact).
Co-founders Peter Thiel (Stanford BA/JD) and Alex Karp (Stanford JD) met at Stanford Law (fact).
Thiel earned a Stanford BA (philosophy, 1989) and JD (1992) and founded The Stanford Review (fact).
Zuckerberg founded Facebook (now Meta) while a Harvard undergraduate in 2004 (fact).
Substantial Stanford-affiliated founder/researcher pipeline into OpenAI (illustrative affiliation, not a funding tie; grade: contested-strength).
Berkeley AI-safety/ML research community is a notable talent source for Anthropic (illustrative affiliation; grade: weak).
CMU (machine learning / robotics) is a recurring source of AI-lab research talent (illustrative affiliation; grade: weak).
